Emergencies

ラムエアインレットドア故障

A malfunction where the ram air inlet door fails to open or close properly, affecting ventilation and cooling of avionics or cabin systems.

Definition

A malfunction where the ram air inlet door fails to open or close properly, affecting ventilation and cooling of avionics or cabin systems.

Operational example

ATC, we have a ram air inlet door failure, temperature regulation affected, no impact on pressurization.

Localized term
